author: Ayeda Okambawa
name: SAM3
description: Generates selection masks using Meta's Segment Anything 3 model, including a text-prompt mode, via the sam3-tools helper.
description-extensive: Like the SAM2 tool but using the newer Segment Anything 3 model, and it can also create masks from a text description of what you want to select. It needs the sam3-tools helper program installed.
